subject.title: Feature: Message continuation marker for batched input (cost savings)

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared user-configured continuation-marker policy for cross-channel inbound aggregation, or keep timer-based debounce and queue collection as the supported batching model?
rationale: This is a new configuration and message-grouping contract whose timeout, channel consistency, visible marker, and fallback semantics cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Specify a shared continuation policy
options.body: Define typed marker, timeout, flush, and channel/command/media semantics in core or a documented generic SDK seam before a focused implementation is accepted.

options.title: Keep existing timer batching only
options.body: Treat `messages.inbound` debounce and queue collection as the supported cost-saving path and close the request only after that product choice is explicitly recorded.

recommendation.title: Specify a shared continuation policy
recommendation.body: Define typed marker, timeout, flush, and channel/command/media semantics in core or a documented generic SDK seam before a focused implementation is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer-side review and adjacent shared inbound-policy history make this the strongest available routing candidate.
